story.storyContextArabic: يكتشف ليث أن المشكلة ليست الماء وحده بل غياب المعلومات الواضحة.
story.storyMissionArabic: يتعلم ليث القيادة عبر موضوع: المشكلة الحقيقية.

lines.narrationArabic: يكتشف ليث أن المشكلة ليست الماء وحده بل غياب المعلومات الواضحة.

lines.englishReference: We need to talk about the missing information.
lines.arabicTranslation: نحتاج إلى الحديث عن the missing information.

lines.targetText: Secondo me il vero problema sono le informazioni poco chiare.
lines.englishReference: In my opinion, the real problem is unclear information.
lines.arabicTranslation: في رأيي، the real problem is unclear information.
lines.pronunciation: Secondo me il vero problema sono le informazioni poco chiare.

lines.targetText: Perché le persone non possono pianificare senza i fatti.
lines.englishReference: Because people cannot plan without facts.
lines.arabicTranslation: لأن people cannot plan without facts.
lines.pronunciation: Perché le persone non possono pianificare senza i fatti.

lines.targetText: Suggerisco di condividere apertamente i numeri.
lines.englishReference: I suggest that we should share the numbers openly.
lines.arabicTranslation: أقترح أن we should share the numbers openly.
lines.pronunciation: Suggerisco di condividere apertamente i numeri.

lines.englishReference: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.

scenes.promptArabic: استعمل رأيًا وسببًا واقتراحًا في موقف عمل أو دراسة.

lines.targetText: L'incontro del villaggio ha sollevato domande utili.
lines.englishReference: The village meeting raised useful questions.
lines.pronunciation: L'incontro del villaggio ha sollevato domande utili.

lines.targetText: Alcune domande è meglio lasciarle per dopo.
lines.englishReference: Some questions are better left for later.
lines.arabicTranslation: بعض الأسئلة من الأفضل تركها لوقت لاحق.
lines.pronunciation: Alcune domande è meglio lasciarle per dopo.
